Concrete changes / scope
1. serve/server.py: QUEUE_BEAT_S=10s and timed single-turn FIFO acquire instead of blocking context-manager acquire. Waiting yields existing ping event translated to SSE keep-alive by unchanged API handlers. ExitStack registers release only after successful acquire and holds ownership through existing generation/accounting/finally. Generator close/exception at waiting ping decrements queued exactly once and leaves other request's lock intact. Cancellation checked before waiting and after successful acquire: zero-output done/cancel, no ensure_loaded/generate, releases an acquired own turn if cancellation races with acquire. Waiting cancellation latency bounded by heartbeat interval when lock remains held. Request-close cannot be observed before any generator suspension; existing caller cancellation/event mechanism remains. Queued events do not overwrite active busy status/history/last/totals. Batch/slot/control path still uses null turn; existing parallel registration/admission flow unchanged (no upstream #1603 scheduling rewrite).
2. READY max_context failure raises EngineDied (RuntimeError subclass) retaining original reason/log hint/tail. Existing startup kill/wait/pipe handling unchanged. EngineDied uses existing request-path503 handler instead of uncaught bareRuntimeError. Existing restart retry catches subclass as before, preserves waiting structures. Restart finally always clears starting, notifies existing slot_cv only if created; lazy first-start failure before postREADY initialization no longer AttributeError-masks startup cause. Does not create/replace waiter condition/lock.
3. New test_queue_keepalive.py: upstream875d6a... fixture port with existing SPDX/LGPL notices. Actual MockEngine+loopbackSSE queued pings followed by answer, queuedcancel and generatorclose accounting; earlycancel noFIFO/noGEN and deterministic cancellation/acquire race releases only its own realLock. HTTP test owns FIFO cleanup even on assertionfailure. Five source tests, no model/GPU/childprocess.
4. New test_ready_timeout.py: upstream32a2439... tests adapted to existing test_restart_waiters actualPython fakeprocess Popen seam, no shell/cmdwrapper/Windows feature changes. Fake neverREADY firstlazy and fakeREADY thensilent restart through realService+loopbackHTTP:503 reason/nextrequestrestart text, startingfalse/fifo released/queued0. CurrentPython used explicitly; controlledfakeprocess lifetime bounded by existing READY timeout and close; no actual process executed by implementer. Two source tests.
